    Recording studio gift voucher in Warsaw

    Looking for a present that someone will actually remember? A recording studio gift voucher in Warsaw from Sanctum Sound lets a singer, rapper or musician step into a real studio, work with a sound engineer and walk away with their own finished song.

    A gift for a musician, singer or rapper

    It’s a gift for a musician who has been writing songs at home, for a friend who sings at every party, or for a young rapper with verses ready to go. No studio experience is needed — a sound engineer guides every session, from setting up the microphone to the final take.

    Voucher packages

    Choose the package that fits the person and the occasion:

    • One song — 2 hours of recording with a sound engineer, plus mixing and mastering of one song
    • Song + production — help with the arrangement and production, recording, then mixing and mastering
    • Rehearsal or studio time — a voucher for the number of hours you choose

    What the recipient gets

    The recipient books a date that suits them and records at our studio in Praga-Południe, with access to professional microphones and gear. With the song packages, they receive a mixed and mastered track ready to share or release. It’s a way to record a song as a gift that lasts far longer than the day itself.

    Delivery and validity

    We send the voucher as a PDF by email, or you can have it printed to hand over in person. The validity period is agreed when you buy it, so you can match it to the occasion.

    Price and how to order

    Voucher prices are available on request. To order a recording studio gift voucher in Warsaw, use the contact form on this site, call +48 881 238 684 or message @sanctum_sound_studio on Instagram, and tell us which package you’d like.

    Questions and answers

    How much does a studio gift voucher cost?

    Prices are available on request. Contact us with the package you have in mind and we’ll send you the details.

    How long is the voucher valid?

    The validity period is agreed at the time of purchase.

    Does the recipient need any recording experience?

    No. A sound engineer runs every session and guides the recipient through it, step by step.

    How will I receive the voucher?

    As a PDF sent by email, or printed if you’d like to hand it over in person.

    Book a session
